reader.requirement: At --std 85, when a PERFORM writes procedure-name-1 THRU procedure-name-2 and either names a procedure (paragraph or section) of the declaratives portion, both must be procedures of the same declarative section; a range from a declarative section into the nondeclarative portion, from the nondeclarative portion into one, or across two declarative sections is refused, whatever TIMES/UNTIL/VARYING phrase follows.
reader.edition-search: Read BindPerform's out-of-line THRU arm and CheckDeclarativesRange (section identity test, no edition parameter); grepped both for Edition.Edition, DialectLevel, ConstructRegistry, DialectBehavior: none. Segmentation.CheckProcedures on the same path is the 1985 segmentation rule, not this one.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers one range shape; not exercised are section-to-paragraph ranges inside one declarative section, nondeclarative-to-declarative ranges, two declarative sections, and a range with a TIMES phrase

probes.expected: D1-P1 THRU D1-P2, D1 THRU D1-P2 and D1-P1 THRU D1 (same declarative section, performed from the nondeclarative portion) accepted and run

probes.printed: COBOL2186 'D1-P2' THRU 'D2-P1' (two declarative sections); dcr4 'D1' THRU 'D2' same
COBOL2186 'M-P2' THRU 'D2-P1' (nondeclarative into declarative); dcr5 'D2-P1' THRU 'M' (paragraph to nondeclarative section) same
COBOL2186 for PERFORM D1-P1 THRU M-P2 2 TIMES
probes.expected: refused: the rule holds for every format with THRU

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.21.3 SR11  (6.21.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR11

reader.notes: The check compares the owning SectionInfo object of both resolved ends before the range is composed, so every straddling shape probed is refused and same-section ranges (section or paragraph ends) are admitted. The rule text is identical across editions and the code takes one arm at every --std.

refuter.evidence: At --std 85: rdpos (paragraph name P in both declarative section D1 and nondeclarative section M, referenced qualified): PERFORM P OF D1 THRU D1-P2 VARYING N FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL N > 2 printed D1-P D1-P2 D1-P D1-P2; the UNTIL N > 1 form then ran zero times (N = 3); OPEN INPUT of a missing file entered declarative D2, which runs PERFORM P OF D1 THRU D1-P2 (a range in another declarative section, legal: both ends in D1) and printed D2-IN D1-P D1-P2, then FS 35. rdr1: P OF D1 THRU P OF M, P OF M THRU P OF D1, the same with VARYING (Format 4) and D1 THRU M WITH TEST AFTER UNTIL (Format 3) each refused COBOL2186.
